title: Line Points Ignore Hover and Controlled Opacity

complexity.rationale: New opacity encoding logic is needed in one function (getLineStaticPoint) plus a signature extension to pass through interaction options; vega-spec-builder-s2's linePointUtils.ts already implements the correct pattern to port.

summary: Static points on an S1 line mark stay at full opacity during hover dimming, controlled highlighting, and other interaction states because getLineStaticPoint() encodes no opacity at all, while the parent line mark's getLineOpacity() covers five interaction states.
symptom: Static points on a line mark stay at full opacity when the parent line is dimmed — during hover interactions (other series highlighted) and when controlled opacity/highlighting is applied. Points and their line visually disagree.
rootCause: getLineStaticPoint() in vega-spec-builder/src/line/linePointUtils.ts (lines ~73-107) encodes no opacity whatsoever in either its enter or update blocks. The parent line mark encodes opacity in its update block via getLineOpacity() (lineMarkUtils.ts:132-219), which branches on interactiveMarkName's HOVERED_ITEM signal (hover dimming, dimension hover, group highlight), CONTROLLED_HIGHLIGHTED_TABLE/CONTROLLED_HIGHLIGHTED_SERIES (controlled highlight), and SELECTED_SERIES (popover selection) — none of which static points receive. By contrast, vega-spec-builder-s2's getLineStaticPoint() (linePointUtils.ts:40-69) already has an update.opacity encoding via its own getOpacity() helper, which correctly handles isAnimate, legend highlight, and hover state for points. The S2 file is not buggy — it is the reference implementation the S1 fix should mirror.

comparison.aspect: opacity key in encode.enter (S1 line mark vs. S1 static point)
comparison.expected: A base opacity production rule, matching how the line mark itself is encoded
comparison.actual: No opacity key present in getLineStaticPoint()'s enter block

comparison.aspect: opacity key in encode.update (S1 line mark vs. S1 static point)
comparison.expected: getLineOpacity(lineMarkOptions), covering hover dimming, controlled highlight, selection, dimension hover, and group highlight (lineMarkUtils.ts:132-219)
comparison.actual: No opacity key present in getLineStaticPoint()'s update block — points always render at full alpha regardless of interaction state

comparison.expected: S2's linePointUtils.ts:40-69 calls a local getOpacity(lineOptions) helper in update, handling isAnimate/legend/hover for points
comparison.actual: S1's linePointUtils.ts has no equivalent helper or call — this is the pattern to port, not re-derive

crossCutting.notes: touchesControlledHighlight and touchesTooltipOrPopover are true because getLineOpacity() branches on CONTROLLED_HIGHLIGHTED_TABLE/CONTROLLED_HIGHLIGHTED_SERIES and on interactiveMarkName's HOVERED_ITEM/SELECTED_SERIES signals (set by the voronoi hover/tooltip and popover system) — the fix must thread these through to points. touchesHoverAnimation and touchesLegendInteraction are false in S1: grep confirms neither hoverAnimationUtils.ts nor legendHighlightSignals-equivalent signals are referenced anywhere in vega-spec-builder/src/line/lineMarkUtils.ts or legendSpecBuilder.ts — those mechanisms are S2-only. requiresS1S2Parity is false because S2 already implements this correctly (vega-spec-builder-s2/src/line/linePointUtils.ts:40-69's getOpacity()) — it's a reference to copy the pattern from, not a second location needing the same fix.

implementationPlan.change: Bug location. getLineStaticPoint() has no opacity key in enter or update. Add opacity: getOpacityProductionRule(opacity) to enter and opacity: getLineOpacity(lineMarkOptions) to update, extending the function's parameter to accept the LineMarkOptions shape getLineOpacity expects.
Reference only — getLineOpacity() here is the function to reuse for the static point's update.opacity encoding.
Reference only — getMarkOpacity()/getOpacityProductionRule() helpers for the point's base enter.opacity.
Reference implementation — getLineStaticPoint()'s existing getOpacity() helper already solves this correctly for S2; port the same approach to S1 rather than re-deriving it.
No opacity test cases exist for static points today (fill/stroke/sparkline only). Add cases mirroring lineMarkUtils.test.ts's getLineOpacity coverage.

openQuestions: Should getLineStaticPoint's signature be extended to accept LineMarkOptions directly, or should the caller pass only the specific fields getLineOpacity needs?
